pieces.Text: You take on the power of an air elemental, gaining the ability to fly and to control powerful gusts of wind. [Minor Form] You gain a +
enhancement bonus to your Dexterity score.

[Major Form] Your shape changes to that of a Medium air elemental (Bestiary p120). While you are in this form, you gain a fly speed of 60 feet (average maneuverability) and airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against you.

[Major Form] Your shape changes to that of a Medium air elemental (Bestiary p120). While you are in this form, you gain a fly speed of 100 feet (perfect maneuverability) and airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against you. You gain the whirlwind special ability. [Whirlwind (Su)] You can transform yourself into a whirlwind as a standard action for
rounds. This otherwise functions as per the whirlwind universal monster rule.
You gain Improved Natural Attack with your slam.
